DIAGNOSIS READY: Transient Synovitis (Toxic Synovitis) of the Left Hip.

The normal inflammatory markers, hip ultrasound, and knee imaging rule out infection and structural damage. Since the anterior drawer test is negative and there is no family history of sickle cell disease, the most likely cause of your limp and knee pain in a 7-year-old boy is transient synovitis, which often presents with referred pain to the knee despite the pathology being in the hip.
